title: Self-Pay Visit Package Forfeited Visits in Appointment Series Same-Day Cancellation Fees
content:
Revenue Cycle memo — the patient's Self-Pay Visit Package history and the same-day cancellation fee on an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The same-day package-forfeit share is 150 percent where the patient's Self-Pay Visit Package history shows two or more package visits forfeited for missed appointments in the three months up to the assessment date (an entry counts when fewer than three whole months separate its date from the assessment date), 125 percent where it shows exactly one, and 100 percent where it shows none. The share is read as a percentage of the same-day basis and multiplies it.

**Records read.** The forfeited package visit entries in the patient's Self-Pay Visit Package history, by date.

| Forfeited package visits, three months up to the assessment date | Share |
|---|---|
| two or more | 150 percent |
| one | 125 percent |
| none | 100 percent |

**Edge (hypothetical, assessment on 9 January).** A forfeiture dated 10 October of the previous year counts; one dated 9 October does not.
